title: skywire lang file
description: A lang file: the templates and settings one wiregen generator uses. Only its shape is checked here; which templates a generator needs is up to the generator (README, Lang(uage) Files).

$schema.description: This schema, for editors. wiregen ignores it.

includes.description: Includes or imports every generated file needs, such as the language's runtime. They come before a specification's own.

stringValues.description: Templates and settings, by name. Tokens such as __MEMBERNAME__ mark where generated text goes.

language.description: The generator this lang file is for.

fileName.description: Output file name pattern. {classname} and {classname_snake} stand for the class name as is and in snake_case.

nativeTypes.description: The member types that are not messages. A member type outside this list (and not string) names a nested message.
